name: Knox Survivors
description: Persistent single-player human survivor/NPC mod for Project Zomboid Build 42. ModForge is an optional coordination/indexing desk; Codex/OpenCode remain fully usable directly from the repository.
vision: Build Knox Survivors into a coherent, persistent single-player survivor ecosystem for Project Zomboid Build 42 without trading reliability or vanilla-world integration for feature count.
design_rules: A Knox survivor is another Project Zomboid survivor controlled by AI, not a colony-game pawn.
Connect existing systems through clear arbitration, claims, needs, history, and loaded/off-screen continuity before adding isolated feature families.
Preserve the established architecture and authoritative gameplay boundaries before adding new systems.
Use real game state and real inventory/resource transfers; never fabricate supplies, completion evidence, or world state.
Treat implemented, offline-tested, live-tested, and release-ready as different states.
Prefer the smallest correct change and validate the affected boundary before expanding scope.
Keep routine AI context small; load historical audits and deep research only when relevant.
Codex handles the hardest implementation and system-expansion work; OpenCode is the budget lane for fixes, support, research, compatibility, and scoped collaboration work.
ModForge optionally coordinates state, priorities, documentation, agents, handoffs, and evidence; it is not the primary implementation engine or a prerequisite for development.

implementation_authority.rule: Once implementation is assigned, Codex/OpenCode own technical execution inside the approved task/architecture boundaries; ModForge coordinates and records rather than competing with the patch.

common_external_sources: Project Zomboid console.txt supplied/located by the owner
launcher/Java console output when startup is the failing boundary
focused test output for the active work item
diagnostics.rule: Do not preload or continuously ingest debug/console logs. Inspect only the smallest recent/relevant slice when a runtime symptom, failing test, or owner report makes logs useful.

source_write_policy.rule: ModForge may maintain managed production/design records. Any write outside managed paths requires explicit per-project owner approval in ModForge. Every ModForge file write is recorded in .modforge/changes/CHANGE_LEDGER.md.
